description: E2 numerical results. Errors are relative to the peak pixel of the reference image; 'max_worst' = worst over the 3 sub-pixel positions of the max abs error; 'rms_mean' = mean over positions.
stand_in_kernels: STAND-INS (analytic pupil), to be replaced by kernels learned from real data

sharp|point|0.note: point source: reference is the tabulated pixel-integrated kernel at the exact 1/8-px offset; no 8-vs-16 test

point_source_snap_error_scale.note: max |T(x)-T(x+shift)|/peak of the exact pixel-integrated kernel: the error a point source suffers when snapped to a grid point shift px away. Route 2 snaps to the nearest sample (<= 1/(2n) px). The test offsets are multiples of 1/8 px, so grids with n multiple of 8 hit them exactly: those point-source numbers are not representative of generic positions.

assumptions: items are Sersic n=1 (half-light radius 2 px and 32 px, axis ratio 0.5)
small items rendered on a 65x65 stamp, large on 257x257; kernel +-32 px (route 2 includes a 32 px margin of fine grid)
per-item times measured on one thread of a shared machine, additive; no overlap/batching, no culling, no GPU
route 1 time excludes fitting the Gaussians (they would be the model's parameters); route 2 excludes kernel tabulation
images of overlapping items are summed at negligible extra cost (stamp add not timed)
